title: NCEZID Divisions and Offices | NCEZID | CDC
content: November 14, 2024 NCEZID Divisions and Offices Overview NCEZID is made up of seven divisions and three offices that work with partners throughout the United States and around the world to prevent illness, disability, and death caused by a wide range of infectious diseases. Because the diverse workforces of these divisions include an equally broad spectrum of infectious disease expertise, we are better able to identify mysterious—and sometimes very lethal— illnesses, contain outbreaks that sometimes span many states, and save lives. Learn more about NCEZID's divisions and offices and what they do below. NCEZID Divisions About Division of Global Migration Health DGMH works to ensure safe global movement to protect human health. Nov. 20, 2023 About Division of Foodborne, Waterborne, and Environmental Diseases DFWED works to protect the public from diseases spread through food, water, and the environment. Nov. 16, 2023 About Division of High-Consequence Pathogens and Pathology DHCPP works to protect the public from deadly diseases like Ebola and anthrax. Nov. 14, 2023 About Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion DHQP protects patients and healthcare workers through safe healthcare delivery systems. Aug. 16, 2024 About Division of Infectious Disease Readiness and Innovation DIDRI works to ensure the public health system can detect and respond to infectious disease threats. Nov. 14, 2023 About Division of Parasitic Diseases and Malaria DPDM works to save and improve lives worldwide by controlling and preventing parasitic diseases. Nov. 20, 2023 About Division of Vector-borne Diseases DVBD works to identify and respond to vector-borne diseases that affect human health. Dec. 5, 2023 NCEZID Offices About CDC's One Health Office Find out who we are and what we do. Global Health NCEZID's Global Health Vision is to equitably protect populations from infectious disease threats.
